info.name: Nikyfarm API - Category / Product / ProductVariant
info.description:
Automated test cases for the Nikyfarm catalog module (Category, Product, ProductVariant, Product Images).

Run order matters: run the whole collection top-to-bottom via Collection Runner (Category -> Product -> Product Variant -> Product Image -> Cleanup). Requests chain via collection variables (categoryId, productId, variantId, secondVariantId) that are set automatically by earlier requests' test scripts.

Content-Type notes:
- JSON requests (Product, ProductVariant) explicitly set the `Content-Type: application/json` header.
- multipart/form-data requests (Category create/update, Product Image upload) intentionally do NOT set a top-level Content-Type header (Postman must generate the multipart boundary itself), but the `request` part is explicitly marked with contentType `application/json` so Spring's @RequestPart binds it correctly.
- The two 'Upload Product Image - Success' style requests need a real image file attached manually to the `file` form field before sending; their test scripts detect this and skip gracefully otherwise.

Updated for JWT auth: the 'Auth' folder logs in as the seeded admin (see app.admin.email/app.admin.password in application.properties) and registers two throwaway customer accounts, storing tokens in collection variables. Every write request elsewhere in this collection now sends 'Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}' since catalog writes are admin-only; the new Users/Reviews/Review Images/Wishlist/Cart folders exercise the customer-facing, JWT-scoped endpoints.
